name: wisebits-chat
description: Wisebits Chat Application - Full Stack Chat with Stories

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend && mkdir -p backend/frontend-build && cp -r frontend/build/* backend/frontend-build/
scripts.test:e2e:playwright: pnpm --filter frontend run build && (pnpm --filter frontend preview & sleep 5 && pnpm --filter frontend run test:e2e; kill $!)
scripts.test:e2e:bdd: pnpm --filter frontend run build && (pnpm --filter frontend preview & sleep 5 && pnpm --filter frontend run test:bdd; kill $!)
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:e2e:bdd
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run docker:build && pnpm run docker:up
scripts.start:dev: docker-compose up mongo -d && concurrently "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"
